title: Helwit Salmiak Nicotine Pouches 12mg / Pouch
description: Helwit Salmiak Nicotine Pouches deliver a strong, liquorice-forward flavour rooted in traditional Scandinavian taste. Salmiak refers to ammonium chloride liquorice - a deeply savoury, slightly salty variation known for its rich, earthy intensity and unmistakable flavour. This pouch is designed for experienced users who enjoy complex, bold profiles with an edge. Each pouch contains 12mg of nicotine and is crafted from soft, plant-based fibres for a discreet, comfortable fit under the lip. The slow, steady nicotine release offers a long-lasting experience with no smoke, vapour or odour. Produced in Sweden with a climate-compensated manufacturing process, Helwit Salmiak is a bold, uncompromising choice for those who favour distinctive flavour and stronger delivery. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
